# Framework Laptop 16 — Modular, Repairable 16" Laptop (AMD Ryzen AI 300 Series)

**Category:** Laptop computer
**MSRP:** Starting at $1,249 (DIY Edition), $1,599 (pre-built)

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Release Year | 2025 |
| Processor options | Ryzen AI 5 340 (6c/12t, up to 4.8GHz); Ryzen AI 7 350 (8c/16t, up to 5.0GHz); Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 (12c/24t, up to 5.1GHz) |
| NPU | Up to 50 TOPS |
| Processor Power | Performance: 45W sustained/54W boost; Balanced: 40W/48W; Efficiency: 30W/36W |
| Integrated Graphics | Radeon 860M (8 cores, Ryzen AI 7 350) or Radeon 890M (16 cores, Ryzen AI 9 HX 370) |
| Discrete Graphics (Expansion Bay) | NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop GPU (8GB or 12GB GDDR7, up to 100W TGP) or Radeon RX 7700S (2nd Gen, 32 CUs, 8GB GDDR6) |
| Display | 16" 16:10 anti-glare matte, 2560x1600, 165Hz, VRR/FreeSync, G-Sync (with RTX 5070 + Display Kit 2nd gen), 500 nit, 100% DCI-P3 |
| Memory | Up to 96GB DDR5-5600 across 2x SO-DIMM sockets (bring your own or buy from Framework) |
| Primary Storage | Up to 8TB WD_BLACK NVMe M.2 2280 (bring your own or buy from Framework) |
| Secondary Storage | Up to 2TB WD_BLACK SN770M NVMe M.2 2230 (x2 PCIe 4.0 interface) |
| Connectivity | AMD RZ717 Wi-Fi 7 module |
| Expansion Cards | 6x user-selectable slots: USB-C, USB-A, HDMI, DP, Ethernet, MicroSD, SD, Audio, or storage |
| Expansion Bay Interface | PCIe x8 for graphics or non-graphics modules (e.g. dual M.2 storage) |
| Battery | 85Wh, 80% capacity at 1000 cycles |
| Camera | 1080p 30fps, Omnivision OV08X 9.2MP sensor, 87° FOV, hardware privacy switch |
| Audio | Stereo Bi-amp speakers (1W tweeter + 2W woofer) with ALC1318 smart amp; 2x MEMS mics with hardware privacy switches |
| Biometrics | Fingerprint reader (Windows Hello and libfprint on Linux) |
| Keyboard | Hot-swappable, backlit, 1.5mm key travel, QMK firmware, NKRO; RGB or white backlight options |
| Touchpad | 122.6 x 76.6mm Windows Precision Touchpad or 124.0 x 77.0mm Haptic Touchpad, matte glass |
| Mechanical | CNC aluminum top cover, magnesium alloy thixomolded bottom cover, 155° hinges (6.1kg force profile) |
| Dimensions (with Expansion Bay Shell) | 356.58 x 270.00 x 17.95mm, 2.10kg |
| Dimensions (with Graphics Module) | 356.58 x 290.20 x 20.95mm, 2.40kg |
| Power Adapter | 240W or 100W GaN USB-C (bring your own also supported) |
| Bezel Colors | Black, Orange, Lavender |
| Warranty | 1-year limited |

## Notable Features
- Fully modular input deck — keyboard, touchpad, numpad/macropad, and spacers are all hot-swappable
- Expansion Bay allows generational GPU upgrades (RTX 5070 or Radeon RX 7700S) independent of the rest of the laptop
- 6 user-selectable Expansion Card slots let you mix and match USB-C, USB-A, HDMI, DisplayPort, Ethernet, card readers, and storage
- Strong Linux support, with Framework publishing recommended distros and open-source design documentation on GitHub
- Repair-first design: replaceable parts sold individually through the Framework Marketplace, no proprietary lock-in on memory/storage
- Sustainability-focused build: majority recycled aluminum/magnesium chassis, recycled plastics, carbon-offset shipping
